              AND {_NO_CARD_YET}
            ORDER BY b.term, b.number
            LIMIT ?

            JOIN publications p ON p.term = b.term AND p.number = b.number

              AND b.entry_into_force IS NOT NULL AND b.entry_into_force <= ?

            "
